name: Darién National Park
story: Darién National Park is a World Heritage Site in Panama covering 5,790 square kilometers. It acts as a natural bridge spanning North and South America and features rocky coastlines, mangroves, swamps, and tropical forests. Two native tribes dwell inside the park.
matters: The park is rich in biodiversity and contains numerous threatened species. It is a protected area inhabited by humans and is adjacent to the Los Katíos National Park in Colombia.
